entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return an order. An order for a helmet.
Okay, I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Look, I'm a bit short on time. It's the wrong color. The box is unopened. Can I return it or not? It's a simple question.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up that order for you. One moment... Okay, I see the helmet was delivered 23 days ago. Is that correct?
Sounds about right. So, can I send it back?

Yes, absolutely. For a standard item like this, you're well within our 90-day return period. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear and that your safety is never compromised by the wrong fit or color. I've just approved the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file.
Okay, great. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with for your VeloFit account today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
